builds.title: Quaggoth shaft guide, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 5 (3 racial HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral beast-follower. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +8. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4.
actions: One claw +8 for 1d4+5. Full attack with two claws at +8 each for 1d4+5 and a secondary bite at +3 for 1d4+2. All threaten on 20 and deal ×2 on a critical hit.
If rage triggers, AC drops to 11 and grapple rises to +10. Full attack becomes two claws at +10 for 1d4+7 each and a bite at +5 for 1d4+3. Hit points and saves stay the same.
Take 10 with Climb +13 for a result of 23 while using the shaft wall.
builds.tactics: Rusk climbs the shaft first to reach a brace for the party’s rope. Check for rage the round after he takes damage. If he rages, he fights the attacker with claws and bite.

builds.title: Quaggoth switchback guard, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 6 (3 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral magic-follower. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +4, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.

Dyed fur grants +2 circumstance on Hide in shadow. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fighter bonus feat is Weapon Focus (club). The 4th-Hit-Die ability increase went to Strength.
actions: Club +10 melee in two hands for 1d6+7 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Without the club, the natural full attack is two claws at +9 for 1d4+5 each and a secondary bite at +4 for 1d4+2.

After taking damage, check next round. On 1 on a d6, Borr drops his club, rages, and uses two claws at +11 for 1d4+7 each and a bite at +6 for 1d4+3. AC drops to 13 and grapple rises to +11. Hit points and saves stay the same.
builds.tactics: Borr waits beside the switchback where shadows break up his dyed fur. He holds the turn with his club until driven back or forced into rage.

concepts.name: Rusk Chalkback
concepts.motive: Reach the high brace so the party can cross without losing the rope.
concepts.hook: Rusk points out a rough seam that leads past the broken ladder.

concepts.name: Borr Sootmane
concepts.motive: Keep the switchback clear until his companions reach the lower passage.
concepts.hook: Borr waits with his club where the shaft light stops at a bend.
